final: WITH per_media AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) AS overall_avg FROM per_media) SELECT p.media_name, p.avg_bpms, p.avg_bpms - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM per_media p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_bpms > o.overall_avg ORDER BY above_overall DESC
